redactionTab.intro: Text matching these rules is replaced before it leaves Provisa: in exported traces and logs, container output, the audit log and every error message returned to a client, including one inside a successful answer. A client receives [REDACTED], which names no rule. Logs, traces and the audit log keep [REDACTED:<rule>]. The organization's own secrets are redacted automatically.
redactionTab.bestEffort: Redaction is best effort. The built-in patterns are only a starter set, so add patterns here for your organization's own sensitive formats. A source's own logs are out of Provisa's reach.
redactionTab.unresolved: These reference rules do not resolve and redact nothing: {{names}}
redactionTab.automaticHelp: Secrets in this organization's vault and every secret its model names, by name only. Values resolved for individual users are added as they are used ({{count}} so far).
redactionTab.name: Name
redactionTab.saved: Saved. The rules apply from now on.
